author: PokerFace
body:
Hello. I present to you Jaloopa!

This is my first CTW map and probably the first one you will ever see that has TNT in it as well. For some reason, people don't put TNT in their CTW maps so I decided to try something different. The team size will be a 30v30.
*I will take away the TNT if things get out of hand.

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/YjoHT
YML: (Will be done by Dawning_)
Download Link: http://www.mediafire.com/download/8f9hoo9911atg5w/Poker3.rar
Regarding having this as a tournament map, I honestly don't think that it's suited for the tournament at it's current state. A problem I can already see is the size of the map. However, if any Map Developer sees potential in this, by all means, edit this map so it could be suited for tournaments. Please contact me over skype if you do happen to.

As always, any feedback is appreciated. Thank you.

replies.body: It's good, but I don't think CTW and TnT works together on a public server. People will troll around with the TnT which will be a problem. Other than that, the map looks well constructed, visually appealing and it is suitable for a public match. Good job on this.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
I don't really think that TNT would work best in a CTW map, more over a tournament map. I like the defence layout, but the front lines could be improved. I also feel like the map is a bit too big, or that's just from my point of view. So it might be a good idea to remove/add some pathways. That's all I see from the pictures, i'll upload the world into singleplayer later and review it more.
Nice work so far :)
